environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 native image deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-rest extension. PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance in same VPC. Database connection uses role 'inventory_app' which has been granted ALL PRIVILEGES on the inventory schema including SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and DDL operations. Connection pool: Agroal with max-size=5. No WAF or API Gateway request validation configured. Lambda function URL is publicly accessible with AuthType=NONE.

config.network: Lambda and RDS in same VPC, no additional network restrictions
